'''Xorem''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as part of the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during part of the war, where he fought against the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War]].

==Biography==
Xorem was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. During the war he held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and was deployed on the Republic-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> While stationed on the planet, he and all Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="TOR" />

During the civil war Xorem was stationed within the Republic stronghold [[Fort Garnik]]. The Separatist movement [[Attack on Mannett Point|attacked]] and captured the island of [[Mannett Point]], located near the Fort, and while doing so destroyed the bridge connecting the island to the mainland. This trapped many citizens on the island, preventing them escaping the conflict. This angered Xorem, particularly as an associate of his, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jaen Kett]], was amongst those trapped.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Xorem asked other Republic individuals to find Kett and safely return him to Garnik. They located the doctor, who was hiding in the island's medical center, where he was caring for several children orphaned in the attack. He refused to leave the island without the children and told the pair that they must return to Xorem and request a number of boats and other supplies to safely evacuate the children and himself from the island. The pair returned to Xorem and informed him of Kett's request, which he initially declared would be hard to fulfill but agreed to upon advice from the pair.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
Whilst stationed in Garnik, Xorem wore a [[Color/Legends|blue]] and white uniform. He was armed with a black [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], which he kept in a holster strapped across his chest.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xorem is a non-player character from the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is involved in a single quest, "Victims of War," available to characters of the trooper or smuggler classes. Players of the Imperial faction cannot interact with Xorem as there is currently no way Imperial characters can travel to Ord Mantell. In the 7.0 update, his animation model was updated to have a black beard and a man bun.<ref name="TOR" />
